target.profile: HID contacts; Cue Helper MediaProjection native frames (REGION, SNAP); no screencap anywhere in the three runs

question: Can the phone clear FNaF 1's hardest mode, Custom Night 20/20/20/20 (4/20), with a route priced at this handset's measured timings?
answer: Yes, once: the first 4/20 attempt reached 6 AM and the title gained its third star.

calibration.what: Open-loop choreography of every route control (both lights with each door open and shut, both doors, the monitor, CAM 4B, both pans) while every native-region frame was recorded on the host clock. Nothing moves before the 2 AM row, so no input could be unsafe.

measured.originNote: The clock puts 1 AM 90 x 1000 ms plus the 17 ms first-reach load after the origin; the hour text read 1 AM 89.92 s after the first office frame, so the origin is ~97 ms before that frame on the helper's image clock. One night.

touchDownLatencyMs.meaning: press start to the first native frame whose region changed (image time)

touchUpLatencyMs.meaning: lights and doors act on touch-UP: the 160 ms contact plus 6-87 ms

regionReadMs.where: FNaF 1 title, full 7713-sample night set, one adb forward

measured.staticRoom: Consecutive native frames of a still office are pixel-identical (frame-to-frame p50 0 in every region), so a region is compared with the template of the state the room is in.
measured.flicker: The door lights flicker: 10 of 61 lit left-doorway frames of the EMPTY room rendered as the unlit room.

positiveControl.result: Alive at the stop. Bonnie was read at the door four times (30.3, 65.3, 95.7, 130.3 s: about 450 ms after his roll each time) and Chica three times, and each door was shut and reopened around the right roll.
positiveControl.detector: occupied read 8.93 (left) and 7.31 (right) from the lit empty template; the empty lit scene read <= 2.71; threshold 4
positiveControl.defectFound: A flickering lit frame with Bonnie at the door matched the UNLIT empty room (2.71) and read 'clear'. Fixed before the 4/20 run: only the LIT empty template is 'clear'; a frame matching the unlit room is 'flicker', which no rule acts on.

fourTwenty.ended: STOP_AFTER at 538.0 s of night time (the route's bound), not LEFT_OFFICE
fourTwenty.terminal: SNAP frames after the night read the hour text rolling '5 AM' -> '6 AM'; the title read after the title-gated restart showed three stars where it had shown two
fourTwenty.detector: occupied min 5.54, clear max 1.72 against threshold 4 (Freddy and Chica on CAM 4B narrowed the occupied side from 7.31 to 5.54)
fourTwenty.foxy: Never looked at. A CAM 4B flick ending ~300 ms before each of his 5010 ms rolls re-sets his hold to >= 50 frames (833 ms) [g460], so every roll fails [g321] and he never leaves the cove; the same raised view keeps Freddy out of the office [g556: viewing <> 42].

findings: The sourced night is the one the phone runs: the hour lasts 90 s (1 AM at 89.92 s after the first office frame), not the 60 s a background-contaminated read first suggested.

FNaF 1's lights and doors act on touch-up and its monitor on touch-down, so the 160 ms contact is paid in full on every light and door press. The device lane now models both (releaseLandingMs 166-247, pressLatencyMs 8-52).

The game vibrated 20 times during the 4/20 night, each within ~0.12 s of a light press on the phone's clock (host and phone clocks were not aligned). Candidate reading: FNaF 1 vibrates when the light reveals someone at a door -- a vision-independent occupancy sensor. UNKNOWN(not-tested): not correlated against the detector's per-press verdicts yet.
notMeasured: Reliability: one 4/20 night is one night, not a cohort.
The night origin offset (-97 ms) is from one calibration night; the route does not yet re-anchor on the observed 1 AM.
Power at 6 AM on the phone: no power reader exists; the model's prediction for this route is min 24 / median 71 units (typical lane).
Whether a contact shorter than 160 ms is taken by FNaF 1's touch-up rules.

frames.note: Game frames and region pixels are never committed (docs/evidence/README.md publishing boundary). This record is the derived reading; the winner binding is tools/device/fnaf1-custom-night7-420-grid420-winner.json.

rung: A DEVICE_MEASURED 6 AM for FNaF 1 4/20 on its own terminal. No Plan 12 promotion edge is recorded, and the evidence CLI does not read FNaF 1 run records yet.
